final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM status_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT value FROM avg_share)) AS average_amount_above_average FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT value FROM avg_share)
